description: A small gray fridge door is in front next to a toy kitchen unit, and inside the lower shelf are a toy burger, a banana, and a red apple-like fruit. The right hand grips the fridge handle and pulls the door outward to open it, then reaches in to take out the burger, then the banana, then the red fruit, placing each on the floor in front of the fridge while the left hand stays low and mostly still; finally the right hand swings the door back toward closed.
